{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
original_rows = len(sales)
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]
print(f"Removed {original_rows - len(sales_clean)} QA orders")

# Filter out refunded orders since they are not completed conversions
# Conversion rate is defined as completed checkouts, so refunded orders should not count as conversions
sales_final = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Now compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = sales_final.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].agg(['sum', 'count']).reset_index()
conversion_rates['conversion_rate'] = conversion_rates['sum'] / conversion_rates['count']

# Print conversion rates
print("Conversion rates by segment:")
print(conversion_rates[['customer_segment', 'conversion_rate']])

# Find the segment with highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates.loc[conversion_rates['conversion_rate'].idxmax(), 'customer_segment']
print(f"Highest conversion rate segment: {highest_segment}")"}
